scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d db redis
scripts.backend:migrate: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml run --rm backend python manage.py migrate
scripts.backend:seed: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml run --rm backend python manage.py seed_demo
scripts.test:backend: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml run --rm backend pytest
